result.instructions: Tools for BrightHR, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are currently employed, and what are their job titles?"; "When did Jane Smith clock in and out this week?"; "Which absences were approved for our team in December?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BrightHR data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run brighthr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run brighthr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run brighthr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. brighthr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: brighthr_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees of your BrightHR organisation with name, job title, start and end dates, email, external reference and registration/termination status. Filter by email, external reference or termination status. Paginated: pass the returned continuationToken to get the next page. BrightHR Customer API: POST /employees/v1/query.

email.description: Only employees with this email address.

externalReference.description: Only employees with this external reference.

isTerminated.description: true for leavers only, false for current employees only.

continuationToken.description: continuationToken from the previous response; omit for the first page.

tools.name: brighthr_set_employee_external_reference
tools.title: Set an employee's external reference
tools.description: WRITE: set or clear the external reference of one employee (1-36 characters; several employees may share one). Use it to link a BrightHR employee to an id in another system. Replaces any existing value. Pass null to clear it. BrightHR Customer API: PUT /employees/v1/{employeeId}/external-reference.

externalReference.description: The new external reference (1-36 characters), or null to clear it.

tools.name: brighthr_list_clockings
tools.title: List clock-ins
tools.description: List Blip clock-in records of one employee: clock-in and clock-out times with time zones, breaks and notes, within an optional date range. Paginated with continuationToken. BrightHR Customer API: POST /blip/v1/clockings/query.

from.description: Start or end of the range, as the API's date or date-time string (for example 2026-01-31).

to.description: Start or end of the range, as the API's date or date-time string (for example 2026-01-31).

continuationToken.description: continuationToken from the previous response; omit for the first page.

tools.name: brighthr_list_absences
tools.title: List approved absences
tools.description: List approved absences of one employee within an optional date range: holiday, sickness, time off in lieu (TOIL) and other. Lateness is not included. Each item has a $type field. Paginated with continuationToken. BrightHR Customer API: POST /absences/v1/query.

from.description: Start or end of the range, as the API's date or date-time string (for example 2026-01-31).

to.description: Start or end of the range, as the API's date or date-time string (for example 2026-01-31).

continuationToken.description: continuationToken from the previous response; omit for the first page.
